about: Factory engine and transmission codes by make/model/powertrain. Records with optionIncludes match the FuelEconomy.gov dropdown path; records with engineInfoIncludes match the NHTSA VIN decode path; records with neither match both paths as a fallback.

records.transmissionCode: Honda Y1 5-speed close-ratio manual / S80 5-speed manual
records.label: Acura B18C DOHC VTEC 1.8L
records.note: B18C1 in GS-R (170 hp); B18C5 in Type-R (195 hp, 8400 rpm redline). Paired with Honda short-ratio 5MT.

records.label: Acura RSX K20 DOHC i-VTEC 2.0L
records.note: Type-S: K20A2 (200 hp) or K20Z1 (210 hp). Base RS/LS: K20A3 (160 hp). All 2.0L DOHC i-VTEC.

records.label: Acura NSX C30A/C32B mid-mounted V6
records.note: C30A 3.0L 270 hp (1991-96); C32B 3.2L 290 hp (1997-2005). DOHC VTEC. Mid-engine longitudinal layout.

records.label: Acura TL J32 SOHC VTEC 3.2L V6
records.note: J32A2 in 2002-03 Type-S (260 hp); J32A3 in 2004-06 (258 hp). All 3.2L VTEC V6.

records.label: Acura TL J35 SOHC VTEC 3.5L V6
records.note: 2007-2014 TL used J35-series 3.5L V6 (280 hp). Available with SH-AWD.

records.label: BMW S14 inline-4 2.3L / 2.5L
records.note: E30 M3 (1988-1991). S14B23 2.3L (200 hp Euro / 192 hp USDM); S14B25 2.5L for Sport Evo. High-revving naturally aspirated 4-cyl.

records.label: BMW S50/S52 inline-6 3.0–3.2L
records.note: E36 M3 (1995-1999). USDM used S52B32 3.2L (240 hp); Euro used S50B30 3.0L or S50B32 3.2L (321 hp).

records.transmissionCode: Getrag GS6-37BZ 6-speed manual / SMG II 6-speed sequential
records.label: BMW S54 inline-6 3.2L
records.note: E46 M3 (2001-2006). S54B32 3.246L DOHC 333 hp (Euro 343 hp). Redline 8000 rpm. Paired with Getrag 6MT or SMG paddle-shift.

records.transmissionCode: Getrag GS7D36SG 7-speed M DCT / Getrag 6-speed manual
records.label: BMW S65 V8 4.0L
records.note: E90/E92/E93 M3 (2008-2013). S65B40 4.0L V8 414 hp, 8400 rpm redline. Naturally aspirated V8 derived from M5 S85.

records.transmissionCode: Getrag GS7D36SG 7-speed M DCT / Getrag GS6-45BZ 6-speed manual
records.label: BMW S55 twin-turbo inline-6 3.0L
records.note: F80 M3 (2015-2020). S55B30 3.0L twin-turbo 425–444 hp depending on spec. Also in F82/F83 M4.

records.transmissionCode: Getrag 7-speed M DCT (F82) / ZF 8HP76 M 8-speed M DCT (G82) / 6-speed manual
records.label: BMW S55 / S58 twin-turbo inline-6 3.0L
records.note: F82 M4 uses S55B30 (425 hp); G82 M4 uses S58B30 (473 hp base, 530 hp Competition). S58 also in G80 M3.

records.label: BMW S62 V8 5.0L
records.note: E39 M5 (1999-2003). S62B50 4941cc V8 400 hp. Double-VANOS. Naturally aspirated. Paired with Getrag 6MT only.

records.label: BMW S85 V10 5.0L
records.note: E60 M5 (2006-2010). S85B50 5.0L V10 507 hp, 8250 rpm redline. SMG III paddle-shift only (no traditional automatic).

records.transmissionCode: Getrag GS7D36SG 7-speed M DCT (F10) / ZF 8HP M 8-speed (F90/G30)
records.label: BMW S63 twin-turbo V8 4.4L

records.transmissionCode: ZF 6HP28 6-speed automatic / Getrag GS6-37BZ 6-speed manual (N54) — ZF 8HP45 8-speed automatic / Getrag GS6-45BZ 6-speed manual (N55)
records.label: BMW N54 / N55 turbo inline-6 3.0L
records.note: N54B30 twin-turbo (300 hp) used 2007-2012; N55B30 single twin-scroll turbo (300 hp) from 2011-2015. Check build date. N54 used in 135i, 535i, X6 35i, Z4 35i. N55 in later 135i, 535i, X5 35i, Z4 35i.

records.label: BMW N54 / N55 turbo inline-6 3.0L
records.note: 1-series coupe/convertible 135i. N54 twin-turbo (300 hp) 2008-2012; N55 single turbo 2012-2013.

records.transmissionCode: ZF 8HP76 8-speed automatic / ZF 8HP45 8-speed automatic / 6-speed manual (select markets)
records.label: BMW B58 turbo inline-6 3.0L
records.note: F30 340i / G20 330i (2019+) / G20 340i. B58B30 single twin-scroll turbo, 320–382 hp. Also in 440i, 540i, 740i, Z4 M40i, Toyota Supra A90, X5 40i.

records.label: BMW B46/B48 turbo inline-4 2.0L
records.note: G20 330i / F30 328i. B48B20 255 hp. Also in 230i, 430i, 530i (B46/B48 family). Shares architecture with Toyota 2.0T in some markets.

records.label: BMW N20 turbo inline-4 2.0L
records.note: F30 328i / F10 528i (2012-2016). N20B20 240 hp. Also in 428i, 228i, X3 28i, X5 28i. Replaced the N52 naturally aspirated 6-cyl.

records.label: BMW N52 naturally aspirated inline-6 3.0L
records.note: E90 328i / E60 528i (2006-2012). N52B30 230 hp. Also in 128i, X3 3.0i, Z4 3.0i. DOHC Valvetronic without turbo.

records.label: BMW M54 / N52 naturally aspirated inline-6 2.5L
BMW N63 twin-turbo V8 4.4L
records.note: E60/F10 550i. N63B44 400-445 hp. Also in 650i, 750i (N63). Hot-V configuration with turbos inside the engine vee. Also used in X5 50i, X6 50i.

records.label: GM LS1 V8 5.7L
records.note: 1998-2002 Camaro SS. LS1 5665cc V8 305 hp (Camaro) / 350 hp (Corvette). All-aluminium Gen III small block.

records.transmissionCode: TR6060 6-speed manual / 6L90 6-speed automatic (LSA) — TR6060 6-speed manual / 8L90 8-speed automatic (LT4)
records.label: GM LSA / LT4 supercharged V8 6.2L
records.note: Camaro ZL1. LSA 580 hp; LT4 650 hp. Both use Eaton TVS supercharger. LT4 is Gen V with direct injection.

records.transmissionCode: TR6060 6-speed manual / 6L80 6-speed automatic (LS3) — TR6060 6-speed manual / 8L90 8-speed automatic (LT1)
records.label: GM LS3 / LT1 V8 6.2L
records.note: Camaro SS 2010-2015: LS3 6162cc 426 hp. 2016-2023: LT1 6162cc 455 hp with direct injection and Active Fuel Management.

records.label: GM LS1 / LS6 V8 5.7L
records.note: C5 Corvette (1997-2004). LS1 5665cc 345 hp (base); LS6 5665cc 385-405 hp (Z06). All-aluminium Gen III small block.

records.label: GM LS2 V8 6.0L
records.note: C6 Corvette base (2005-2007) and Pontiac GTO 2005-06. LS2 5967cc V8 400 hp.

records.engineCode: LS3 (base) / LS7 (Z06) / LSA (ZR1 C6) / LT1 (C7) / LT4 (C7 Z06)
records.transmissionCode: TR6060 6-speed manual / 6L80 automatic (LS3/LT1) — Getrag 7-speed dry-clutch DCT (C8)
records.label: GM LS3/LS7/LT1/LT4 V8 6.2L
records.note: C6 LS3 430 hp; C6 Z06 LS7 7.0L 505 hp; C7 LT1 455 hp; C7 Z06 LT4 650 hp supercharged. Confirm which variant before ordering parts.

records.label: GM 5.3L V8 LS/LT small block
records.note: Iron-block LM7 in older trucks; aluminium EcoTec3 L83/L84 from 2014+. Active Fuel Management cylinder deactivation standard from 2007+.

records.transmissionCode: TREMEC TR6060 6-speed manual / NAG1 (W5A580) 5-speed automatic / TorqueFlite 8HP70 8-speed automatic
records.label: Dodge HEMI 5.7L V8
records.note: Standard Challenger R/T (2008+). 5654cc 375 hp. MDS Multi-Displacement System standard. Also in Charger R/T, 300 C, Ram 1500 5.7 HEMI.

records.label: Dodge Hellcat 6.2L supercharged HEMI V8
records.note: 2015+ Challenger SRT Hellcat. 6166cc with 2.4L Eaton TVS supercharger, 707 hp (Redeye 797 hp). Also Charger SRT Hellcat.

records.label: Dodge 392 6.4L HEMI V8
records.note: 2011+ Challenger SRT 392 / SRT8. 6424cc 485 hp. Apache engine plant. Also in Charger SRT 392, Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT.

records.engineCode: Romeo 4.6L 2V SOHC V8 (GT 1996–2004) / Windsor 4.6L 3V SOHC V8 (GT 2005–2010)
records.transmissionCode: T45 / T3650 5-speed manual / 4R70W 4-speed automatic (1996-2004) — TR3650 5-speed manual / 5R55S 5-speed auto (2005-2010)
records.label: Ford 4.6L Modular SOHC V8
records.note: GT (1996-2004): 260 hp 2-valve. GT (2005-2010): 300 hp 3-valve. Both 4.6L Modular family. Also in F-150, Crown Victoria, Town Car.

records.label: Ford Shelby GT500 5.4L supercharged DOHC V8
records.note: 2007-2012 Shelby GT500. 5.4L DOHC with 2.3L Eaton TVS supercharger, 500-550 hp. All-aluminium block. TR6060 manual only.

records.label: Ford EcoBoost 2.3L turbo inline-4
records.note: 2015+ Mustang EcoBoost. 2.3L 310-330 hp. Same block as Focus RS (350 hp high-output). Also in Explorer 2.3T, Ranger 2.3T.

records.label: Ford EcoBoost 3.5L twin-turbo V6
records.note: 2011+ F-150. Gen 1: 365 hp; Gen 2 (2017+): 375 hp with port and direct injection. Also in Explorer Platinum, Expedition, Lincoln Navigator.

records.transmissionCode: GETRAG MTX75 6-speed manual (FWD) / Borg Warner AWD unit
records.label: Ford Focus RS EcoBoost 2.3L high-output
records.note: 2016-2018 Focus RS. High-output EcoBoost 2.3L 350 hp. AWD with torque vectoring. Same base block as Mustang EcoBoost 2.3L.

records.label: Honda K24 DOHC i-VTEC 2.4L
records.note: 2003-2017 Accord 4-cyl. K24-series 2.4L inline-4 in all generations. 160-192 hp depending on year and tune. Also in CR-V, Element, TSX, RDX (K23A1).

records.label: Honda J30 SOHC VTEC 3.0L V6
records.note: 2003-2007 Accord V6. J30A4 240 hp; J30A5 244 hp. All-aluminium SOHC VTEC V6. Replaced by J35 in 2008.

records.label: Honda J35 SOHC i-VTEC 3.5L V6
records.note: 2008-2017 Accord V6. J35 3.5L 268-278 hp. Same family as Odyssey, Pilot, Ridgeline V6.

records.label: Honda L15B7 DOHC VTEC turbo 1.5L
records.note: 2018+ Accord 1.5T. L15B7 192 hp. Also in 2016+ Civic 1.5T, 2017+ CR-V. Port and direct injection. Honda's main 4-cyl turbo from 2016+.

records.label: Honda K20C4 DOHC VTEC turbo 2.0L
records.note: 2018+ Accord 2.0T. K20C4 252 hp. De-tuned version of the Civic Type R's K20C1 (306 hp). Available with 6MT or 10AT.

records.label: Honda K20 DOHC i-VTEC 2.0L
records.note: Civic Si (2002-2011). K20A2 197 hp (EP3); K20Z3 197 hp (FA5). Manual only. 8300 rpm redline. Also in RSX Type-S (K20A2/K20Z1).

records.label: Honda L15B7 DOHC VTEC turbo 1.5L
records.note: 2016+ Civic Sedan/Hatch (non-Si/Type-R). L15B7 158-174 hp. Same unit as Accord 1.5T and CR-V 1.5T but different tune.

records.label: Honda K20C DOHC VTEC turbo 2.0L
records.note: 2017+ Civic Type R: K20C1 306 hp. 2017-2021 Civic Si: K20C2 205 hp. Manual only for both. K20C1 also in Accord Sport 2.0T detuned as K20C4.

records.label: Honda K24 DOHC i-VTEC 2.4L
records.note: 2002-2016 CR-V. K24-series 2.4L 166 hp. Same engine family as Accord 4-cyl but different tune.

records.label: Honda L15B7 DOHC VTEC turbo 1.5L
records.note: 2017+ CR-V. L15B7 190 hp. CVT standard. Same L15B7 family as Civic and Accord but CR-V tune.

records.label: Honda F20C DOHC VTEC 2.0L
records.note: 2000-2005 S2000 (AP1). F20C1 2.0L 240 hp, 9000 rpm redline. One of the highest naturally-aspirated specific-output engines ever mass-produced. Manual only.

records.label: Honda F22C1 DOHC VTEC 2.2L
records.note: 2006-2009 S2000 (AP2). F22C1 2.2L 237 hp, 8000 rpm redline. Increased torque over F20C. Manual only.

records.label: Honda H22 DOHC VTEC 2.2L
records.note: 1997-2001 Prelude (BB6 VTEC). H22A4 195 hp (USDM). JDM H22A 220 hp. DOHC VTEC 4-cyl. Popular engine swap candidate.

records.label: Honda J35 SOHC i-VTEC 3.5L V6
records.note: 2005+ Odyssey minivan. J35-series 3.5L V6 244-280 hp. Cylinder deactivation (VCM) from 2011. Same J35 family as Accord V6, Pilot, Ridgeline.

records.label: Honda J35 SOHC i-VTEC 3.5L V6
records.note: 2003+ Pilot. J35 3.5L V6 244-280 hp. AWD standard. VCM cylinder deactivation from 2009. Also in Acura MDX.

records.label: Honda J35 SOHC VTEC 3.5L V6
records.note: All generations Ridgeline. J35-series 3.5L 280 hp. Direct injection in Gen 2 (2017+). AWD.

records.label: Hyundai Theta II G4KF 2.0L turbo
records.note: 2010-2016 Genesis Coupe 2.0T. G4KF 210 hp (2010-12) / 274 hp R-Spec (2013-16). Same Theta II block as Sonata 2.0T, Optima 2.0T.

records.label: Hyundai Lambda II G6DU 3.8L V6
records.note: 2010-2016 Genesis Coupe 3.8 Track. G6DU 348 hp. DOHC V6 with CVVT. Paired with Torsen LSD in R-Spec manual.

records.transmissionCode: Hyundai N 6-speed manual / 8-speed wet DCT N DCT
records.label: Hyundai G4KH Theta II 2.0L turbo high-output
records.note: 2019+ Veloster N. G4KH 250-275 hp. N Light DCT 8-speed available 2021+. Also in i30 N, Elantra N.

records.transmissionCode: JATCO RE5R05A 5-speed automatic / Aisin AY6 6-speed manual
records.label: Nissan/Infiniti VQ35DE V6 3.5L
records.note: 2003-2007 G35 Coupe/Sedan. VQ35DE 280-298 hp. Shared with 350Z, Altima 3.5, Maxima 3.5. HR variant (VQ35HR) in 2007+ G35.

records.transmissionCode: JATCO 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters / Aisin 6-speed manual
records.label: Nissan/Infiniti VQ37VHR V6 3.7L
records.note: 2008-2013 G37. VQ37VHR 328 hp. VVEL variable valve lift. Also in 370Z, Q60 (2014-15), Q70 (V6 version).

records.label: Kia G6DP Lambda II 3.3T twin-turbo V6
records.note: 2018+ Stinger GT. G6DP 365 hp. ZF 8HP twin-scroll turbo V6. Also in Genesis G70, G80, G90. RWD and AWD.

records.label: Kia G4KH Theta II 2.0T
records.note: 2018+ Stinger 2.0T. G4KH 255 hp. Same Theta II family as Veloster N / Sonata 2.0T but slightly different tune.

records.label: Toyota/Lexus 2JZ-GE inline-6 3.0L NA
records.note: 2001-2005 IS300 (JCE10). 2JZ-GE naturally aspirated 215 hp. Same block as Supra but no turbos. Popular turbo conversion platform due to shared block with 2JZ-GTE.

records.label: Toyota/Lexus 2JZ-GE inline-6 3.0L NA
records.note: 1992-2000 SC300 (JZZ30). 2JZ-GE 225 hp. Same block as Supra. W58 5-speed manual or A650E auto. Popular swap candidate using 2JZ-GTE.

records.label: Lexus/Toyota 2UR-GSE V8 5.0L
records.note: 2008-2014 IS-F. 2UR-GSE 416 hp. Direct injection 5.0L V8. Also in RC-F (2015+) and LC500 (5.0L 471 hp version). Sequential-shift 8AT.

records.label: Lexus 2UR-GSE V8 5.0L
records.note: 2015+ RC F. 2UR-GSE 467 hp (with Carbon Package 472 hp). Same engine as IS-F with higher tune. Torsen LSD standard.

records.label: Toyota/Lexus 2UZ-FE V8 4.7L
records.note: 1998-2007 LX470. 2UZ-FE 4.7L 235 hp. Iron block V8. Also in 4Runner V8, Land Cruiser 100, Tundra 4.7, GX470, Sequoia. Extremely reliable.

records.label: Toyota/Lexus 3UR-FE V8 5.7L
records.note: 2008-2021 LX570. 3UR-FE 5.7L 383 hp. Also in Land Cruiser 200, Sequoia, Tundra 5.7. DOHC aluminium V8 with VVT-i.

records.label: Mazda 13B-REW twin-turbo rotary 1.3L
records.note: 1993-1995 USDM FD RX-7. 13B-REW sequential twin-turbo 255 hp (USDM). Engine is a 2-rotor 1308cc Wankel. Uses 10W-30 oil injected for apex seals. Cooling system maintenance critical.

records.label: Mazda 13B-MSP Renesis naturally aspirated rotary 1.3L
records.note: 2004-2011 RX-8. 13B-MSP 232 hp (6-speed manual) / 197 hp (automatic). Side-port NA rotary. Higher oil consumption is normal. Flooding during warm-up can cause flooding and failure.

records.label: Mazda L3-VDT 2.3L turbo inline-4
records.note: 2007-2013 Mazdaspeed 3. L3-VDT 263 hp. Same unit as Mazdaspeed 6 and CX-7. FWD only with 6MT. Well-known for torque steer.

records.label: Mazda L3-VDT 2.3L turbo inline-4
records.note: 2006-2007 Mazdaspeed 6. L3-VDT 274 hp. AWD. Same block as Mazdaspeed 3 and CX-7 but higher output.

records.label: Mazda BP-ZE DOHC 1.8L
records.note: 1994-2005 Miata 1.8L. BP-ZE 133-140 hp. Naturally aspirated. Rear-wheel drive. NA6 (1990-93) used 1.6L B6-ZE.

records.transmissionCode: Mazda 6-speed manual / 6-speed automatic (NC) — Mazda 6-speed manual / 6-speed automatic (ND)
records.label: Mazda LF / PE 2.0L Skyactiv-G
records.note: NC MX-5 (2006-2015): LF-VE/LF-VDS 167-158 hp. ND MX-5 (2016+): PE-VPS 155-181 hp Skyactiv-G. ND is 100 kg lighter than NC.

records.label: Mazda PE-VPS Skyactiv-G 2.0L
records.note: 2013-2016 CX-5. PE-VPS 2.0L 155 hp. 14:1 compression ratio. High-pressure direct injection.

records.label: Mazda PY-VPS Skyactiv-G 2.5L / 2.5T
records.note: 2014+ CX-5. PY-VPS 2.5L 187 hp; 2.5T (2021+) 227 hp. Same Skyactiv-G family. Also in Mazda6, CX-9 2.5T, CX-50.

records.transmissionCode: W5M33 5-speed manual / F5M42 5-speed manual (FWD GST) / W5M33 5-speed manual (AWD GSX) / F4A42 4-speed automatic
records.label: Mitsubishi 4G63 / 4G63T DOHC 2.0L turbo
records.note: 1990-1999 Eclipse (1G/2G). 4G63T twin-cam turbo 195-210 hp. GST is FWD turbo; GSX is AWD turbo. 4G63 is also in Galant VR-4, Lancer Evo I-IX.

records.transmissionCode: Evo I-IX: W5M33 5-speed close-ratio manual / Evo X: Aisin 6-speed TC-SST DCT / 5-speed manual (Evo X GSR/RS)
records.label: Mitsubishi 4G63T / 4B11T 2.0L turbo
records.note: Evo I-IX (1992-2007): 4G63T 2.0L 250-321 hp. Evo X (2008-2016): 4B11T 2.0L 291 hp. AWD with active yaw control AYC diff.

records.label: Mitsubishi 4B11T MIVEC 2.0L turbo
records.note: 2008-2016 Lancer Evo X. 4B11T MIVEC 291 hp. Also sold as Lancer Evolution in some markets. Uses cam phasing on both intake and exhaust.

records.label: Mitsubishi 6G72TT twin-turbo V6 3.0L
records.note: 1991-1999 3000GT VR-4 (and Dodge Stealth R/T Turbo). 6G72TT 3.0L twin-turbo 320 hp AWD. Sequential turbos. Also Dodge Stealth R/T Turbo (same drivetrain).

records.label: Mitsubishi 6G72 NA V6 3.0L
records.note: 1991-1999 3000GT SL/base. 6G72 3.0L naturally aspirated 222 hp FWD. Same engine family as VR-4 but no turbos.

records.label: Nissan KA24E / KA24DE 2.4L inline-4
records.note: 1989-1998 240SX (S13/S14). KA24E SOHC 140 hp; KA24DE DOHC 155 hp. Popular SR20DET swap candidate. RWD platform. S14 also available with USDM SR20DE in some markets.

records.label: Nissan VQ35DE / VQ35HR V6 3.5L
records.note: 2003-2008 350Z. VQ35DE 287 hp (2003-2006); VQ35HR 306 hp (2007-2008). Both 3.5L V6. Also in G35, Altima 3.5, Pathfinder, Murano, FX35.

records.transmissionCode: CD009 6-speed manual / JATCO 7-speed automatic with paddle shifters
records.label: Nissan VQ37VHR V6 3.7L
records.note: 2009+ 370Z (Z34). VQ37VHR 332 hp. VVEL variable valve lift system. Also in Infiniti G37, Q60, Q70 V6. Syncrev rev-match system available.

records.label: Nissan VR38DETT twin-turbo V6 3.8L
records.note: 2008+ R35 GT-R. VR38DETT 3799cc 485–600 hp (NISMO/track editions). Twin-turbo V6 with GR6 dual-clutch in rear transaxle. Nissan's hand-built performance engine at Yokohama plant.

records.transmissionCode: RS6F51A 6-speed manual / Xtronic CVT / JATCO 4-speed automatic (2002-04)
records.label: Nissan QR25DE DOHC 2.5L inline-4
records.note: 2002+ Altima 2.5. QR25DE 175 hp. Also in Frontier 2.5, Sentra SE-R, X-Trail. CVT standard from 2007.

records.label: Nissan VQ40DE V6 4.0L
records.note: 2005+ Frontier V6. VQ40DE 261 hp. Also in Pathfinder 4.0, Xterra 4.0. Iron block V6. DOHC.

records.label: Nissan VQ35DE V6 3.5L
records.note: 2004+ Maxima. VQ35DE 265-300 hp. Sport-tuned version of the VQ35. FWD. Also in Murano, Quest, Pathfinder.

records.label: Nissan RB26DETT twin-turbo inline-6 2.6L
records.note: JDM R32/R33/R34 GT-R (1989-2002). RB26DETT 280 hp (official — actual dyno higher). Sequential twin-turbo inline-6. ATTESA AWD. Factory-understated output.

records.label: Nissan SR20DET DOHC turbo 2.0L inline-4
records.note: JDM S13/S14/S15 Silvia (1988-2002). SR20DET 205 hp. Popular engine swap into 240SX. Also in JDM 180SX, USDM Sentra SE-R uses NA SR20DE.

records.transmissionCode: G97/01 6-speed manual / Tiptronic 5-speed auto (996/997) — PDK 7-speed DCT / 7-speed manual (991)
records.label: Porsche 9A1 / MA1 flat-6 3.8L turbo
records.note: 911 Turbo (996/997/991). 3.8L twin-turbo 480-580 hp. PDK standard on 991+. All-wheel drive. Water-cooled (996+).

records.transmissionCode: Getrag G97 6-speed manual (GT3 RS) / PDK 7-speed DCT
records.label: Porsche flat-6 GT3 4.0L
records.note: 991.2 GT3 RS, 992 GT3. 4.0L naturally aspirated 500-510 hp. Revs to 9000 rpm. Available PDK only on some variants.

records.label: Porsche M48 twin-turbo V8 4.8L
records.note: Cayenne Turbo 2003-2017. 4.8L twin-turbo V8 500-520 hp. Same platform as VW Touareg W12, Audi Q7.

records.transmissionCode: TY754 5-speed manual (EJ) / 6-speed manual / TR580 Lineartronic CVT (FA)
records.label: Subaru WRX EJ205 / FA20DIT / FA24F turbo flat-4
records.note: 2002-2005 Impreza WRX: EJ205 2.0L 227 hp. 2015-2021 WRX: FA20DIT 2.0L 268 hp. 2022+ WRX: FA24F 2.4L 271 hp. All AWD symmetrical.

records.label: Subaru WRX EJ255 turbo flat-4 2.5L
records.note: 2006-2014 Impreza WRX. EJ255 2.5L 224 hp. Open-deck block. Distinct from STI's closed-deck EJ257. Prone to ringland failure under hard use.

records.label: Subaru WRX STI EJ257 turbo flat-4 2.5L
records.note: 2004-2021 WRX STI. EJ257 2.5L 305 hp. Closed-deck forged crankshaft. 6MT with driver-controlled DCCD centre diff. STI 6-speed is different from WRX 5-speed.

records.label: Subaru WRX STI EJ257 turbo flat-4 2.5L
records.note: Earlier model name for WRX STI (2004-2007 Impreza WRX STI). EJ257 305 hp. Closed-deck block with 4340 steel crankshaft.

records.label: Subaru Impreza WRX EJ205 turbo flat-4 2.0L
records.note: 2002-2005 USDM Impreza WRX. EJ205 2.0L 227 hp. Twin-scroll single turbo. Open-deck semi-closed aluminium block. Symmetrical AWD.

records.transmissionCode: TY755 5-speed manual / 4-speed auto (EJ XT) — Lineartronic CVT (FA)
records.label: Subaru Forester EJ255 / FA24DIT turbo flat-4
records.note: 2004-2008 Forester XT: EJ255 2.5L 224 hp. 2014-2018: 2.0XT uses FA20DIT 250 hp. 2019+ Sport/Wilderness: FA24DIT 2.4L 260 hp.

records.label: Subaru Outback EJ25 flat-4 2.5L
records.note: All-generation Outback 2.5. EJ253 NA 170 hp (most trims); EJ255 turbo 224 hp (XT trim). From 2020+: FA24 2.4T (Outback XT) / EJ25 replacement with FA24F.

records.label: Subaru EZ36D flat-6 3.6L
records.note: 2010+ Outback 3.6R (and Legacy 3.6R). EZ36D 3.6L H6 256 hp. Naturally aspirated. Smoother and quieter than EJ-series. Popular for reliability. AWD.

records.label: Subaru EZ36D flat-6 3.6L
records.note: 2010+ Legacy 3.6R. EZ36D 3.6L H6 256 hp. Same unit as Outback 3.6R.

records.label: Subaru/Toyota FA20D flat-4 2.0L
records.note: 2013-2021 BRZ (also Toyota 86 / Scion FR-S). FA20D 2.0L 200 hp. Dual-port + direct injection. Front-engined RWD sports car. Boxer layout for low centre of gravity.

records.label: Subaru FA24D flat-4 2.4L
records.note: 2022+ BRZ (also GR86). FA24D 2.4L 228 hp. Larger bore/stroke than FA20. No turbo. RWD. 6MT or 6AT.

records.transmissionCode: Getrag V160 6-speed manual / Aisin A340E 4-speed automatic
records.label: Toyota 2JZ-GTE twin-turbo inline-6 3.0L
records.note: 1993-1998 A80 Supra Turbo. 2JZ-GTE 3.0L sequential twin-turbo 320 hp (USDM) / 280 hp (JDM factory-rated). Iron block, aluminium head. Factory 1000+ hp potential with upgraded internals. Getrag V160 paired with twins.

records.transmissionCode: A340E 4-speed automatic / W58 5-speed manual (A80 NA) — ZF 8HP76 8-speed automatic / Getrag 6-speed manual (A90)
records.label: Toyota 2JZ-GE NA inline-6 3.0L / BMW B58 (A90)
records.note: A80 NA Supra (1993-98): 2JZ-GE 225 hp. A90 Supra (2020+): BMW B58B30M1 382 hp (3.0T). A90 shares platform with BMW Z4 G29.

records.label: Toyota 2AZ-FE DOHC VVT-i 2.4L
records.note: 2002-2011 Camry 4-cyl. 2AZ-FE 2.4L 158-179 hp. Also in RAV4 2.4, Highlander 2.4, Solara, Scion tC. Known for oil consumption if head bolts stretch (2AZ-FE head bolt issue).

records.label: Toyota 2AR-FE / A25A-FKS DOHC VVT-i 2.5L
records.note: 2012-2017: 2AR-FE 2.5L 178 hp. 2018+: A25A-FKS 2.5L 203 hp with Dynamic Force engine. Also in RAV4 2.5, Venza, NX250.

records.label: Toyota 2GR-FE / 2GR-FKS DOHC VVT-i 3.5L V6
records.note: 2006+ Camry V6. 2GR-FE 268-277 hp; 2GR-FKS 301 hp (D-4S). Also in Highlander V6, Sienna, Avalon, Venza, Lexus RX350/ES350/IS350.

records.label: Toyota 1MZ-FE DOHC VVT-i 3.0L V6
records.note: 1997-2006 Camry V6. 1MZ-FE 3.0L 200-210 hp. Also in Sienna 3.0, Avalon, Lexus ES300, RX300. Popular used engine.

records.label: Toyota 1ZZ / 2ZR / M20A DOHC 1.8L inline-4
records.note: All-generation Corolla 1.8. 1ZZ-FE 125-130 hp (known oil consumption); 2ZR-FE 132 hp. 2020+: M20A-FKS 2.0L (most markets) or 1.8L hybrid. Very high parts availability.

records.label: Toyota 1GR-FE DOHC VVT-i 4.0L V6
records.note: 2003+ 4Runner V6 (4th/5th gen). 1GR-FE 4.0L 245-270 hp. Also in FJ Cruiser, Tacoma V6 (2005+), Land Cruiser Prado, Hilux V6, Tundra V6. Extremely durable iron-block V6.

records.label: Toyota 2UZ-FE DOHC VVT-i 4.7L V8
records.note: 2003-2009 4Runner V8 (4th gen). 2UZ-FE 4.7L 235 hp. Also in Land Cruiser 100, LX470, Tundra 4.7, Sequoia 4.7. Iron block. Extremely reliable.

records.label: Toyota 3UR-FE DOHC VVT-i 5.7L V8
records.note: 2007+ Tundra 5.7 iForce (1st/2nd gen). 3UR-FE 5.7L 381-401 hp. Also in Sequoia 5.7, Land Cruiser 200/300, LX570. All-aluminium DOHC V8.

records.label: Toyota 2UZ-FE DOHC VVT-i 4.7L V8
records.note: 2000-2009 Tundra 4.7 iForce. 2UZ-FE 4.7L 245-282 hp. Iron block, aluminium head. Successor to 1UZ-FE.

records.label: Toyota 3UR-FE DOHC VVT-i 5.7L V8
records.note: 2008-2021 Land Cruiser 200 Series. 3UR-FE 5.7L 381 hp. Available in Canada. KDSS suspension standard. One of the most reliable SUVs available.

records.label: Toyota 2UZ-FE DOHC VVT-i 4.7L V8
records.note: 1998-2007 Land Cruiser 100 Series. 2UZ-FE 4.7L 235 hp. Iron block. Legendary reliability. Also in LX470.

records.label: Toyota 1GR-FE DOHC VVT-i 4.0L V6
records.note: 2005+ Tacoma V6 (2nd/3rd gen). 1GR-FE 236-278 hp. Same engine as 4Runner V6. Iron block. Available 4WD with R150F 6MT.

records.label: Toyota 2TR-FE DOHC VVT-i 2.7L inline-4
records.note: 2005+ Tacoma 4-cyl. 2TR-FE 2.7L 159-177 hp. Also in Hilux, Land Cruiser Prado 4-cyl (some markets). Solid, high-mileage engine.

records.label: Toyota 3S-GTE DOHC turbo 2.0L inline-4
records.note: 1991-1995 MR2 Turbo (SW20 Gen 2). 3S-GTE 200 hp. Mid-engine turbo 4-cyl. Also in Celica GT-Four ST205 (245 hp). Known for lift-off oversteer.

records.label: Toyota 2ZZ-GE DOHC VVT-iL 1.8L / 1ZZ-FE 1.8L
records.note: 2000-2005 Celica. GT-S: 2ZZ-GE 180 hp (190 hp JDM with VVTL-i). GT: 1ZZ-FE 140 hp. Same 2ZZ-GE in Lotus Elise/Exige, Matrix XRS.

records.label: Toyota 2GR-FE DOHC VVT-i 3.5L V6
records.note: 2008+ Highlander V6. 2GR-FE 270 hp. Also in Sienna, Venza, Avalon. Same family as Camry 3.5V6.

records.label: VW 1.8T 20V turbo inline-4 1.8L
records.note: Mk4 Golf GTI (1999-2006). 1.8T AEB/AWP 180 hp. Same engine family in Mk4 Jetta GLI, B5 Passat, B5 A4 1.8T, TT 1.8T 225. AEB 150 hp; AWP 180 hp; AMK 180 hp versions.

records.transmissionCode: 02S / DQ250 6-speed manual / DSG 6-speed DCT (DQ250) / DSG 7-speed DCT (DQ381/DQ500)
records.label: VW EA888 2.0T TSI inline-4
records.note: Mk5 GTI (2006-09): BPY 200 hp. Mk6 GTI (2010-14): CBFA/CCTA 200-210 hp. Mk7 GTI (2015-21): CHHB IS20 220 hp; Clubsport 265 hp. Mk7 Golf R: CJXB IS38 292 hp. EA888 Gen 1/2/3.

records.label: VW EA888 2.0T TSI inline-4
records.note: Mk5/Mk6 Jetta GLI. Same 2.0T EA888 as Golf GTI. BPY 200 hp (Mk5); CCTA 200 hp (Mk6). High-pressure direct injection.

records.engineCode: CDLF (Mk6 R) / CJXB (Mk7 R) / DNFA (Mk8 R)
records.transmissionCode: 02S 6-speed manual / DSG 7-speed DCT (DQ381) / DSG 7-speed DCT (DQ500 Mk8)
records.label: VW Golf R IS38 / IS20 2.0T TSI 4Motion
records.note: Mk6 R (2012-14): CDLF 256 hp. Mk7/7.5 R (2015-21): CJXB IS38 292-310 hp. Mk8 R (2022+): DNFA 315 hp. 4Motion AWD. Haldex-based (Mk6-7) or Torsen (Mk8).

records.label: VW/Audi 1.8T 20V inline-4 1.8L
records.note: B5 Passat (1998-2005). AEB/ATW 150 hp; AWM 170 hp. Longitudinal mount (FWD or Syncro AWD). Same engine as B5 Audi A4 1.8T.

records.transmissionCode: 01E 5-speed manual / 5HP19 5-speed auto (B5) — 6-speed manual / 6-speed Multitronic CVT / 6HP19 auto (B6/B7)
records.label: Audi 1.8T 20V inline-4 1.8L
records.note: B5 A4 (1996-2001): AEB 150 hp, AMB 150 hp. B6 A4 (2002-04): BEX 170 hp. B7 A4 (2005-08): BWT 170 hp. Longitudinal mount with Quattro option.

records.label: Audi EA888 2.0 TFSI inline-4
records.note: B7 A4 (2006-08): BWT 200 hp. B8 A4 (2009-16): CDNC 211 hp. B8.5: CZDA 220 hp. All 2.0L FSI/TFSI direct injection. Quattro AWD available.

records.engineCode: CAKA / CGWB (B8/B8.5 3.0 TFSI supercharged) / MGF (B9 3.0T biturbo)
records.label: Audi 3.0 TFSI / 3.0T V6
records.note: B8 S4 (2010-15): CGWB 3.0L supercharged V6 333 hp. B9 S4 (2016+): 3.0T twin-scroll turbo V6 354 hp. Quattro AWD. Both have 8-speed auto options.

records.label: Subaru EJ20 / EJ205 flat-4 2.0L
records.note: EJ20 NA in base Impreza (150-160 hp). EJ205 turbo in WRX trim (227 hp). Symmetrical AWD. JDM STI variants used EJ207 (280 hp).

records.label: Toyota 3UR-FE DOHC VVT-i 5.7L V8
records.note: 2008+ Sequoia. 3UR-FE 381 hp. Same engine as Tundra 5.7, Land Cruiser 200, LX570. Aluminium DOHC V8. RWD or 4WD.

records.label: Toyota 2GR-FE 3.5L V6 / A25A-FXS 2.5L hybrid
records.note: 2011-2020 Sienna: 2GR-FE 296 hp. 2021+ Sienna: hybrid-only A25A-FXS 2.5L with eCVT 243 hp combined. Standard AWD on 2021+ Canadian models.

records.label: Toyota T24A-FTS 2.4L turbo inline-4
records.note: 2022+ Highlander (third gen, Canada). T24A-FTS 265 hp. Direct injection and port injection combined. Also in Venza, Camry XSE V6 replacement. AWD standard in Canada.

records.label: Toyota Avalon 1MZ-FE 3.0L V6
records.note: 1995–2004 Avalon (XX10/XX20). 1MZ-FE 3.0L DOHC VTEC-i 210 hp. FWD. Also in Camry V6, Lexus ES300.

records.label: Toyota Avalon 2GR-FE 3.5L V6
records.note: 2005–2018 Avalon (XX30/XX40). 2GR-FE 268–301 hp. FWD. Same family as Camry V6, Highlander, Sienna.

records.label: Toyota Avalon A25A-FXS 2.5L Hybrid
records.note: 2019–2022 Avalon Hybrid (XX50). A25A-FXS 2.5L Dynamic Force Atkinson with electric motor. 215 hp combined. FWD.

records.transmissionCode: C60 5-speed manual / U241E 4-speed automatic / U241E 5-speed automatic
records.label: Toyota RAV4 2AZ-FE 2.4L inline-4
records.note: 2001–2012 RAV4 (XA20/XA30). 2AZ-FE 2.4L 161–179 hp. AWD option. Also in Camry 2.4, Highlander 2.4, Solara, Matrix.

records.label: Toyota RAV4 2AR-FE / A25A-FKS 2.5L inline-4
records.note: 2013–2018 RAV4 (XA40): 2AR-FE 2.5L 176 hp. 2019+ RAV4 (XA50): A25A-FKS 2.5L Dynamic Force 203 hp. CVT standard on XA50.

records.label: Toyota RAV4 2GR-FE 3.5L V6
records.note: 2006–2012 RAV4 V6 (XA30). 2GR-FE 3.5L 269 hp. Optional V6 in this generation only; discontinued after XA30.

records.transmissionCode: e-CVT with electric rear axle motor
records.label: Toyota RAV4 Hybrid A25A-FXS 2.5L
records.note: 2016+ RAV4 Hybrid. A25A-FXS 2.5L Atkinson + front/rear electric motors. 219 hp combined system output. Standard AWD-i.

records.label: Toyota RAV4 Prime A25A-FXS PHEV 2.5L
records.note: 2021+ RAV4 Prime (XA50 PHEV). 18.1 kWh battery. 302 hp combined. AWD-e. 68 km EV range (WLTP).

records.label: Toyota Prius 1NZ-FXE 1.5L Hybrid
records.note: 2004–2009 Prius (XW20). 1NZ-FXE 1.5L Atkinson + permanent-magnet electric motor. 110 hp combined. NiMH battery.

records.label: Toyota Prius 2ZR-FXE 1.8L Hybrid
records.note: 2010–2022 Prius (XW30/XW50). 2ZR-FXE 1.8L Atkinson 121 hp combined (XW30) / 121 hp (XW50). NiMH or Li-ion.

records.label: Toyota Prius M15A/M20A-FXE 2.0L Hybrid
records.note: 2023+ Prius (XW60). M15A-FXE 1.5L or M20A-FXE 2.0L Dynamic Force Atkinson. 194–220 hp combined. Li-ion battery.

records.label: Toyota Echo 1NZ-FE 1.5L inline-4
records.note: 2000–2005 Echo (NCP10/NCP12). 1NZ-FE 1.5L 108 hp. FWD. Replaced by Yaris in 2006.

records.label: Toyota Matrix 1ZZ-FE / 2ZZ-GE 1.8L
records.note: 2003–2008 Matrix (E130). 1ZZ-FE 126 hp base; 2ZZ-GE 180 hp XRS. All FWD or AWD (1ZZ only). 2009–2014 E140: 1ZR-FE 132 hp / 2ZR-FE 158 hp.

records.label: Toyota Venza 2AR-FE 2.7L inline-4
records.note: 2009–2016 Venza (AV10). 2AR-FE 2.7L 182 hp. FWD or AWD. Same platform as Highlander.

records.label: Toyota Venza 2GR-FE 3.5L V6
records.note: 2009–2016 Venza V6 (AV10). 2GR-FE 3.5L 268 hp. AWD. Discontinued after 2016.

records.label: Toyota Venza A25A-FXS 2.5L Hybrid
records.note: 2021+ Venza (AV80). Hybrid-only model in Canada. A25A-FXS 2.5L Atkinson + dual electric motors. 219 hp combined. AWD-i standard.

records.label: Toyota FJ Cruiser 1GR-FE 4.0L V6
records.note: 2007–2014 FJ Cruiser (J15). 1GR-FE 4.0L 239 hp. Part-time 4WD. Same engine as 4Runner, Tacoma V6.

records.label: Toyota C-HR 2ZR-FAE 1.2T / 2.0L
records.note: 2018–2023 C-HR (AX10). Canadian market: 2ZR-FAE 2.0L 144 hp naturally aspirated. CVT. FWD. Discontinued in Canada after 2023.

records.label: Toyota GR86 FA24D 2.4L flat-4
records.note: 2022+ GR86 (ZN8). FA24D 2.4L 228 hp. Naturally aspirated boxer. RWD. Same engine/platform as Subaru BRZ ZD8.

records.label: Toyota Prius V 2ZR-FXE 1.8L Hybrid
records.note: 2012–2017 Prius V (ZVW41). 2ZR-FXE 1.8L Atkinson 134 hp combined. Larger wagon body. Sold as Prius+ in some markets.

records.label: Toyota 86 FA20D 2.0L flat-4
records.note: 2013–2021 Toyota 86 (ZN6). FA20D 2.0L 200 hp. Shared platform with Subaru BRZ ZC6. RWD. Replaced by GR86.

records.label: Honda HR-V R18Z1 1.8L inline-4
records.note: 2016–2022 HR-V (RU1/RU2). R18Z1 1.8L SOHC i-VTEC 141 hp. FWD or AWD. CVT standard; 6MT on LX trim.

records.label: Honda HR-V LFC 2.0L Hybrid
records.note: 2023+ HR-V (RV). New e:HEV hybrid system. LFC 2.0L Atkinson 158 hp (combined). FWD only in Canada.

records.label: Honda Fit L13A1 1.3L inline-4
records.note: 2003–2008 Fit (GD). L13A1 1.3L SOHC i-DSI 83 hp. FWD. Ultra-compact. Magic Seat system.

records.label: Honda Fit L15A7 / L15B7 1.5L inline-4
records.note: 2009–2014 Fit (GE): L15A7 1.5L 117 hp. 2015–2020 Fit (GK): L15B7 1.5L DOHC VTEC 130 hp. Both FWD. 7-speed DCT available on GK.

records.label: Honda Element K24A4 2.4L inline-4
records.note: 2003–2011 Element (YH2). K24A4 2.4L DOHC i-VTEC 166 hp. FWD or AWD. Boxy crossover. Low floor, washable interior.

records.label: Honda Passport J35Y6 3.5L V6
records.note: 2019+ Passport (YF3). J35Y6 3.5L SOHC i-VTEC 280 hp. FWD or AWD. Based on Pilot platform. Shorter wheelbase than Pilot.

records.label: Honda Insight LDA 1.3L IMA Hybrid
records.note: 2010–2014 Insight (ZE2). LDA-MF6 1.3L Integrated Motor Assist hybrid 98 hp combined. FWD. First dedicated Honda hybrid since original 1999 Insight.

records.label: Honda Insight LEB-H5 1.5L Hybrid
records.note: 2019–2022 Insight (ZE4). LEB-H5 1.5L Atkinson + two electric motors. 151 hp combined. i-MMD two-motor system. FWD.

records.label: Honda CR-Z LEA 1.5L IMA Sport Hybrid
records.note: 2011–2016 CR-Z (ZF1). LEA-MF6 1.5L IMA 130 hp (manual) / 122 hp (CVT). Sport Hybrid 2-seater. +R button for boost. FWD.

records.label: Nissan Sentra GA16DE 1.6L inline-4
records.note: 1991–1999 Sentra (B13/B14). GA16DE 1.6L DOHC 110 hp. FWD. Also SE-R variant with SR20DE 2.0L 140 hp.

records.label: Nissan Sentra QG18DE / MR18DE 1.8L inline-4
records.note: 2000–2019 Sentra. B15: QG18DE 1.8L 126 hp. B16/B17: MR18DE 1.8L 124 hp with CVT. FWD.

records.label: Nissan Sentra HR17DE 2.0L inline-4
records.note: 2020+ Sentra (B18). HR17DE 2.0L 149 hp. CVT only. FWD. Completely redesigned with lower, sportier stance.

records.label: Nissan Murano VQ35DE 3.5L V6
records.note: 2003–2022 Murano (Z50/Z51/Z52). VQ35DE 3.5L 240–260 hp all generations. CVT throughout. FWD or AWD.

records.label: Nissan Pathfinder VQ40DE 4.0L V6
records.note: 2005–2012 Pathfinder (R51). VQ40DE 4.0L 266 hp. 4WD. Also in Frontier V6, Xterra V6.

records.label: Nissan Pathfinder VQ35DD 3.5L V6
records.note: 2013–2022 Pathfinder (R52): VQ35DD 3.5L 284 hp CVT. 2022+ (R53): VQ35DD 284 hp 9AT. FWD or AWD.

records.label: Nissan Xterra VQ40DE 4.0L V6
records.note: 2005–2015 Xterra (N50). VQ40DE 4.0L 261 hp. Body-on-frame. Part-time 4WD with low range. Same engine as Pathfinder/Frontier V6.

records.label: Nissan Versa HR16DE 1.6L inline-4
records.note: 2012–2025 Versa (C11/B17/B18). HR16DE 1.6L 109–122 hp. FWD. CVT Xtronic standard. Budget subcompact.

records.label: Nissan Quest VQ35DE 3.5L V6
records.note: 2004–2017 Quest (V42/E52). VQ35DE 3.5L 235–260 hp. FWD. Minivan. Discontinued after 2017.

records.label: Nissan Armada VK56 5.6L V8
records.note: 2004–2015 Armada (A60): VK56DE 5.6L 305 hp. 2017+ (Y62): VK56VD 5.6L 390 hp with VVEL. Both RWD/4WD. Body-on-frame.

records.label: Nissan Qashqai MR20DD / HR13DDT
records.note: 2017+ Qashqai (J11/J12). MR20DD 2.0L 141 hp CVT or HR13DDT 1.3T 158 hp DCT. FWD or AWD. Canadian compact crossover.

records.label: Nissan Juke MR16DDT 1.6T inline-4
records.note: 2011–2017 Juke (F15). MR16DDT 1.6T 188 hp (NISMO RS). FWD or AWD. AWD uses independent rear motor via CVT+DCT combo.

records.label: Nissan Leaf EM57 Electric
records.note: 2011+ Leaf. Gen 1 (AZE0): 80 kW / 30 kWh battery. Gen 2 (ZE1): EM57 150 kW 62 kWh (Plus). FWD. First mainstream EV in Canada.

records.label: Nissan Kicks HR16DE 1.6L inline-4
records.note: 2018+ Kicks (P15). HR16DE 1.6L 122 hp. FWD. Subcompact crossover. Replaced Juke in Canada.

records.label: Nissan Titan VK56 5.6L V8
records.note: 2004–2015 Titan (A60): VK56DE 5.6L 317 hp. 2016+ (A61): VK56VD 5.6L 400 hp. Also available with Cummins 5.0L V8 diesel.

records.label: Subaru Crosstrek FB20 2.0L flat-4
records.note: 2013–2023 Crosstrek (GP/GT). FB20B 148 hp (2013–2017). FB20D 152 hp (2018–2023). Symmetrical AWD. Also sold as XV.

records.label: Subaru Crosstrek FA24F 2.5L flat-4
records.note: 2024+ Crosstrek (GU). FA24F 2.5L 182 hp. Also available as hybrid. Symmetrical AWD standard.

records.label: Subaru Tribeca EZ36D 3.6L flat-6
records.note: 2006–2014 Tribeca (WX). EZ36D 3.6L H6 256 hp. Symmetrical AWD. 7-seat SUV. Same H6 as Outback/Legacy 3.6R.

records.label: Subaru Ascent FA24F 2.4T flat-4
records.note: 2019+ Ascent (SK). FA24F 2.4L turbocharged 260 hp. Symmetrical AWD. 7- or 8-passenger 3-row SUV.

records.label: Subaru Crosstrek Hybrid PHEV
records.note: 2019–2023 Crosstrek Hybrid. FB20E 2.0L Atkinson + twin electric motors. 148 hp combined. 26 km EV range. Symmetrical AWD.

records.label: Mazda3 LF-DE / PE-VPS 2.0L inline-4
records.note: 2004–2009 BK: LF-DE 2.0L 148 hp. 2014–2018 BM/BN: PE-VPS Skyactiv-G 2.0L 155 hp. 2019+ BP: PE-VPS 155 hp. Manual or Skyactiv-Drive 6AT.

records.label: Mazda3 Z6-DEH / MZR 2.3L inline-4
records.note: 2004–2013 Mazda3 BK/BL GTs. Z6-DEH 2.3L 160 hp. Also in Mazda6 2.3L. Naturally aspirated; not to be confused with Mazdaspeed turbocharged version.

records.label: Mazda3 PY-VPS Skyactiv-G 2.5L
records.note: 2015+ Mazda3 2.5 Skyactiv (BM/BN/BP). PY-VPS 2.5L 184–191 hp. Also in CX-5/CX-30 2.5L. 2019+ BP has cylinder deactivation.

records.label: Mazda6 LF-VE / PE-VPS 2.0L inline-4
records.note: 2009–2012 GH: LF-VE 2.0L 155 hp. 2013+ GJ: PE-VPS Skyactiv-G 2.0L 155 hp. FWD.

records.label: Mazda6 PY-VPS 2.5L / 2.5T
records.note: 2013+ GJ Mazda6. PY-VPS 2.5L 184 hp; 2.5T turbo 250 hp (2018+). FWD. 2.5T also has i-Activ AWD option.

records.label: Mazda CX-9 MZI 3.7L V6
records.note: 2007–2015 CX-9 (TB). MZI L3-VDT 3.7L V6 275 hp. FWD or AWD. 7-passenger. Same V6 family as Mazda RX-9 concept period.

records.label: Mazda CX-9 PY-VPTS 2.5T turbo inline-4
records.note: 2016+ CX-9 (TC). PY-VPTS 2.5T 227–250 hp. FWD or i-Activ AWD. 7-passenger. Same family as CX-5/Mazda6 2.5T.

records.label: Mazda CX-3 PE-VPS Skyactiv-G 2.0L
records.note: 2016–2023 CX-3 (DK). PE-VPS 2.0L 148 hp. FWD or i-Activ AWD. Subcompact crossover based on Mazda2 platform.

records.label: Mazda CX-30 PE-VPS 2.0L inline-4
records.note: 2020+ CX-30 (DM). PE-VPS 2.0L 155 hp. Also available as e-Skyactiv X HCCI 2.0L 181 hp in some markets. FWD or AWD.

records.label: Mazda CX-30 Turbo PY-VPTS 2.5T
records.note: 2021+ CX-30 Turbo. PY-VPTS 2.5T 250 hp. i-Activ AWD. Same engine as CX-9 TC.

records.label: Mazda CX-50 PY-VPS 2.5L inline-4
records.note: 2023+ CX-50 (KK). PY-VPS 2.5L 187 hp. i-Activ AWD standard. Replaces CX-5 in Canada. Also available as 2.5T 256 hp Turbo.

records.label: Mazda CX-50 Turbo PY-VPTS 2.5T
records.note: 2023+ CX-50 Turbo. PY-VPTS 2.5T 256 hp with 93 octane. AWD standard.

records.label: Mazda Mazda5 LF-VE 2.3L inline-4
records.note: 2006–2015 Mazda5 (CR/CW). LF-VE 2.3L 153 hp. Sliding rear doors. 6-passenger compact MPV. FWD.

records.label: Mitsubishi Outlander 4B11 2.4L MIVEC
records.note: 2007–2021 Outlander (CW/GF/GG). 4B11 2.4L 166 hp FWD; 168 hp AWD. INVECS-III CVT. 7-passenger option.

records.label: Mitsubishi Outlander 6B31 3.0L V6
records.note: 2007–2013 Outlander GT (CW). 6B31 3.0L V6 230 hp. S-AWC standard. 3-row 7-passenger.

records.label: Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV 4J12 2.4L
records.note: 2022+ Outlander PHEV (ZM). 4J12 2.4L Atkinson + twin electric motors. 248 hp combined. S-AWC AWD. 37 km EV range.

records.label: Mitsubishi RVR 4A91 / 4B11 MIVEC
records.note: 2011+ RVR (GA). 4A91 1.5L 143 hp (base) / 4B11 2.0L 148 hp (AWD/SE+). CVT with S-AWC AWD. Also sold as ASX.

records.label: Mitsubishi Galant 4G69 / 6G75
records.note: 2004–2012 Galant (9G). 4G69 2.4L 160 hp; 6G75 3.8L V6 260 hp (Ralliart). FWD. Last Galant sold in Canada.

records.label: Mitsubishi Montero 6G74 3.5L V6
